meta.cost_model: products on the matrix multiplier (low-precision dot products of length k) per output entry; Ozaki-I reuses slice products across slice counts (split_prefix) and in the exact fallback; the overlap bound adds one product (support indicators); Ozaki-II configurations cost one product per modulus, without reuse; the exact fallback costs s_e^2 (ozaki1ExactFallback). Not GPU time.
meta.fallback_categories: exact_zero: x.y = 0; tie: x.y exactly halfway between two neighbours in the output format; wide_bound: 4B >= ulp(x.y) at the last rounding test; near_boundary: the rest (x.y within 2B of a rounding boundary with 4B < ulp); representable: x.y a format value (overlaps the others); H_already_exact: H = x.y at the last rounding test yet B > 0.
